proposals.evidence: Turner jūrṇa gives Gujarati jūnũ, Hindi jūnā and Marathi junā old. The surveyed Bhili-area jun-/juṇ- adjectives are compared with that western u-vowel family, preserving their local l-adjectival endings and source-internal spacing. This identifies the root family without positing an undocumented Sanskrit *jūrṇala or merging it with i-vowel jīrṇa.
